purpose: Extend the resolved local SS3 surface from kappa=0.04..0.06 out to kappa=0.07 and 0.08

phase_A_lower_edge.goal: Locate lambda_lower(kappa) for each new kappa slice
phase_A_lower_edge.followup_rule: If the transition is not bracketed, extend the window in the observed direction and rerun only that slice.

phase_B_upper_edge.goal: Locate lambda_upper(kappa) for each new kappa slice
phase_B_upper_edge.followup_rule: If SS3 persists through the coarse window, extend upward; once SS2 appears, refine the true bracket at step 0.001.

notes: This sim extends the closed three-slice surface from sim13.
Use the same SS3/SS2/runaway classification logic as sim11-sim13.
Do not run unnecessary refinements on slices that already bracket cleanly in the coarse pass.
